name: fullsession
description: See how visitors really use your website: frustrated pages, funnel drop-offs and session replays from FullSession.

interface.longDescription:
See how visitors really use your website, right from ChatGPT. Ask about frustrated pages, funnel drop-offs or specific sessions, and get clear answers with charts and links to the session replays.

- Find where visitors struggle and why
- See where your funnels lose people
- Find and replay sessions
- Track trends, read your dashboards and get AI recommendations on what to fix
defaultPrompt: Which pages have the most rage clicks this week?
Where do users drop off in my checkout funnel?
Show me recent sessions with JavaScript errors.

positive.description: Find the pages with the most frustration
positive.prompt: Which pages on 0verclockers.co.uk had the most rage clicks in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card ranking 0verclockers.co.uk pages by rage clicks, with affected sessions per page, and a short summary of the top page. Expanding a page shows the elements that were rage-clicked.

positive.prompt: Which step of my funnel on 0verclockers.co.uk loses the most people in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the site's funnel (or asks which one if there are several), then shows a funnel card with the conversion rate, the count at each step, and the step with the biggest drop highlighted.

positive.prompt: Show me recent sessions on 0verclockers.co.uk that had JavaScript errors.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows session cards with time, device, country, pages visited and an error badge, each with a Replay button. Visitor emails and names are masked.

positive.prompt: How did sessions on 0verclockers.co.uk change over the last 30 days compared to the previous 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a trend chart of daily sessions with the total, a dashed previous-period line and the percentage change, plus a one-line summary.

positive.prompt: Open the most recent session on 0verclockers.co.uk with a JavaScript error and walk me through what happened.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent session with a JavaScript error, then summarizes its timeline: the pages visited in order, the error message and the page it happened on, with a Replay link.

negative.description: General knowledge, not account data. Nothing here needs the user's FullSession data, so ChatGPT should answer on its own without calling FullSession tools.
negative.prompt: What is session replay in general?

negative.description: Unrelated request. It has nothing to do with website analytics, so FullSession tools should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write me a haiku about autumn.

review.commerce_description: FullSession does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: frustration, funnel, session, trend and dashboard analysis with interactive cards, and AI recommendations on what to fix.
